Both collectors use their own strength=0, mix_scope=none, auto masks, selection radius 0. The ON collector receives Slider +4 ONLY via loader 10. Its own strength must remain 0.

FINAL A/B/C use the original style baseline plus Slider +4 in the sampler, manual masks, target_mask selection radius 4, and audit diagnostics. Never feed loader 10 into a FINAL sampler.

Change seed, steps and trial_id consistently on all five Samplers. Change Slider strength at loader 10 and all three FINAL samplers; keep collectors at 0. Keep all seed controls fixed. See the adjacent index JSON and comparison guide for every setting location.

widgets_values:
Only FINAL A/B/C use DiagnosticSave. ON collector has two upstream LoRA loaders, which the current DiagnosticSave provenance validator rejects. Collector references and masks use ordinary SaveImage. Final reports describe manual-mask generation and do not certify collection branch provenance.

Raw target/protected PNGs are display exports of unmodified reference masks, not raw similarity tensors. Keep the workflow JSON with them. Conflict = T_on * P_off; old-only = clamp(T_off - T_on).

Cold full graph: each collector = 2 collection + 8 final = 10 model NFE; each FINAL = 16; total = 68. Isolated A/B = 26; isolated C = 36 only after pruning unrelated output paths. Change all five trial_id values for an uncached repeat. Changing save prefixes alone does not rerun cached Samplers.
